description: One adult at an outdoor Fourth of July cookout in a park, cheeks puffed, five hot dogs sticking out of their mouth, holding a paper plate; red, white and blue bunting on a folding table behind. Only this person in frame.
A folding table with trays of hot dogs and buns, mustard and ketchup bottles, and a hand-written sign reading HOT DOG CONTEST. No people.
An empty apartment living room with stacked moving boxes, a rolled-up rug and bare wood floors. No people.
A birthday cake with lit candles on a restaurant table, plates and glasses around it, no faces.
A city skyline at sunset from a lakefront path, an empty bench in the foreground. No people.
The cabinet under a kitchen sink: a dripping pipe joint, a small bucket catching water, cleaning bottles pushed aside.
A beagle mix puppy on a blanket at an outdoor pet adoption event, a paper tag on its collar. No faces of people.
A gray tabby cat asleep on a sunny windowsill next to a potted plant.
A bowl of turkey chili topped with shredded cheddar and green onions on a wooden table.
A red bicycle locked to a lamp post on a sidewalk covered in autumn leaves. No people.
